en: six-factor matrix
zh: 六因子矩阵

definition.en: A compact table laying out several factors side by side so their readings can be compared at a glance, rather than read one at a time.
definition.zh: 一张紧凑的表格，将多项因子并排列出，便于一眼比较，而无需逐一查看。

why.en: Seeing the factors together makes it easier to notice when most of them agree versus when the picture is mixed.
why.zh: 将各因子并列展示，更容易察觉它们是否一致，还是呈现出分歧的局面。

basis.en: Grid of per-factor state labels
basis.zh: 按因子分列的状态标签网格

en: The matrix is a coincident read-out, not an independent forecast, and each underlying factor already has its own reference entry.
zh: 该矩阵是同期读数展示，并非独立预测；每个底层因子均已有各自的说明条目。

up.en: Most factors pointing the same direction is a more confluent read.
up.zh: 大多数因子指向同一方向，代表信号更趋一致。

down.en: Factors pointing in different directions is a more mixed, lower-confidence read.
down.zh: 各因子方向不一致，代表信号更为混合，置信度较低。

neutral.en: A mixed matrix is common between regime turns and is not itself a signal to act on.
neutral.zh: 在周期转换阶段，矩阵出现分歧较为常见，本身并不构成行动信号。

definition.en: A short list of the specific conditions that have crossed a pre-set threshold recently, shown as a small pill on the dashboard.
definition.zh: 一个简短列表，列出近期越过预设阈值的具体条件，以看板上的小标签形式展示。

why.en: It tells you which specific watch conditions are active right now, without you needing to check every panel yourself.
why.zh: 它让你无需逐一查看每个面板，即可了解当前哪些具体的关注条件正处于激活状态。

basis.en: Count and list of active named conditions
basis.zh: 当前激活的具名条件的数量与列表

en: This is a rules-based watch list, not a forecast or a trade signal.
zh: 这是一份基于规则的关注列表，并非预测或交易信号。

up.en: More fired conditions means more of the pre-set watch list is currently active.
up.zh: 触发数量越多，说明当前处于激活状态的预设关注项越多。

down.en: Fewer or no fired conditions means the watch list is currently quiet.
down.zh: 触发数量减少或为零，说明关注列表当前处于平静状态。

neutral.en: The list can be empty for long stretches — that is a normal, quiet state, not a data gap.
neutral.zh: 该列表可能长时间为空——这是正常的平静状态，而非数据缺失。

en: regime call
market posture read
regime badge
zh: 市场态势
市场状态判断
市场状态徽标

definition.en: A plain-word read of the market's current posture — risk-on, mixed, or risk-off — drawn from the dashboard's composite indicators, shown alongside the day's briefing.
definition.zh: 对市场当前态势的简明判断——风险偏好、混合或避险——来自看板综合指标，与当日简报一并展示。

why.en: Gives a fast, one-word orientation before reading any detail, so you know whether the backdrop currently favours or discourages taking risk.
why.zh: 在查看细节前先给出一个词的方向感，帮助判断当前环境是偏向承担风险还是偏向谨慎。

basis.en: Categorical label (risk-on / mixed / risk-off)
basis.zh: 分类标签（风险偏好／混合／避险）

en: A confirmation-style read of current conditions, not a forecast of what happens next.
Can change quickly when underlying signals flip; check the update time before acting.
zh: 这是对当前状态的确认性判断，不是对未来走势的预测。
底层信号变化时该判断可能迅速更新，行动前请核对更新时间。

up.en: Risk-on — supportive backdrop; trend, breadth, and cross-asset signals broadly line up.
up.zh: 风险偏好——环境偏支持性；趋势、广度与跨资产信号总体一致。

down.en: Risk-off — stressed backdrop; tape under pressure and trend pointing lower.
down.zh: 避险——环境承压；盘面承压，趋势向下。

neutral.en: Mixed — signals disagree or the regime is in transition; treat with extra caution.
neutral.zh: 混合——信号不一致或市场状态处于转换期，应格外谨慎。

0-100 market score
zh: 市场状态评分
状态仪表盘

definition.en: A 0-100 dial summarising current US equity market posture, blending trend, cross-asset risk appetite, volatility, breadth, liquidity, and stress into one composite read.
definition.zh: 0-100综合仪表盘，反映美股当前市场态势，综合趋势、跨资产风险偏好、波动率、市场广度、流动性与压力六项因子。

why.en: Turns six separate market inputs into one glanceable number so you can track whether conditions are improving or deteriorating day to day.
why.zh: 将六项市场输入合并为一个直观数字，方便逐日跟踪环境是在改善还是在恶化。

basis.en: 0-100 composite score
basis.zh: 0-100综合评分

en: A blended confirmation measure of current conditions, not a predictive score.
Individual component legs can pull the score in different directions; check the breakdown before drawing conclusions from the headline number alone.
zh: 这是对当前状态的综合确认性衡量，不是预测性评分。
各分项因子可能方向不一致，仅看总分容易误判，建议查看分项拆解。

up.en: Higher score — trend, breadth, and cross-asset signals broadly align supportive.
up.zh: 评分较高——趋势、广度与跨资产信号总体呈支持性一致。

down.en: Lower score — tape under stress, trend pointing lower, signals aligned negative.
down.zh: 评分较低——盘面承压，趋势向下，信号呈负面一致。

neutral.en: Mid-range score — components disagree or the picture is transitional.
neutral.zh: 评分处于中间区间——各分项不一致，或整体格局处于过渡阶段。

en: posture chip
zh: 态势标签

definition.en: A single dial-shaped readout summarising whether the overall backdrop currently leans risk-on, risk-off, or neutral.
definition.zh: 一个仪表状的综合读数，概括当前整体环境偏向风险偏好、风险规避，还是中性。

why.en: It gives a one-glance summary of overall tone before you look at any individual factor.
why.zh: 在查看任何单项因子之前，先给出整体基调的一目了然的总结。

basis.en: Categorical dial position (risk-on / neutral / risk-off)
basis.zh: 仪表位置分类（风险偏好／中性／风险规避）

en: This is a summary readout of other factors already on the page, not an independent forecast, and it is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or size anything.
zh: 这是对页面上其他因子的综合总结，并非独立预测，也不构成任何买入、卖出或仓位建议。

up.en: A risk-on reading suggests the backdrop is currently leaning supportive.
up.zh: 风险偏好读数表示当前环境偏向支持性。

down.en: A risk-off reading suggests the backdrop is currently leaning defensive.
down.zh: 风险规避读数表示当前环境偏向防御性。

neutral.en: A neutral reading means the summary factors are not leaning clearly either way.
neutral.zh: 中性读数表示各项综合因子暂未明显偏向任一方向。

en: growth-inflation quadrant
macro quadrant
zh: 增长通胀象限
经济周期象限

definition.en: A four-way classification of the macro backdrop by the direction of growth and inflation: e.g. growth rising with inflation falling, or growth falling with inflation rising.
definition.zh: 按增长与通胀的方向变化，将宏观环境划分为四种象限：例如增长上行、通胀下行，或增长下行、通胀上行等组合。

why.en: Different quadrants historically favour different sectors and factors, so it helps frame which parts of the market the backdrop tends to support.
why.zh: 不同象限历史上通常利好不同板块与风格因子，有助于判断当前环境更支持哪类资产。

basis.en: Categorical quadrant label with a stability qualifier
basis.zh: 象限分类标签，附带稳定性说明

en: This is a coincident, market-derived read of the cycle, not an independent forecast of the real economy — it tends to move with price rather than ahead of it.
The label can lag the sign-rule read of today's data during a confirmation window.
zh: 该判断主要由与市场同步的指标推导，属于同期指标而非独立的经济预测，不具备领先性。
在确认期内，该标签可能滞后于当日数据本身的方向。

up.en: Growth up / inflation down — historically the most supportive quadrant for equities.
up.zh: 增长上行／通胀下行——历史上对股票最为有利的象限。

down.en: Growth down / inflation up — historically the most defensive quadrant.
down.zh: 增长下行／通胀上行——历史上最需防御的象限。

neutral.en: Growth and inflation both rising or both falling — a mixed backdrop for sector tilts.
neutral.zh: 增长与通胀同向上行或同向下行——对板块配置而言属于混合环境。

cross-asset risk score

跨资产风险评分

definition.en: One of six factors feeding the Market State Score: cross-asset risk appetite, comparing how risk-seeking versus risk-averse assets are performing relative to each other.
definition.zh: 构成市场状态分的六项因子之一：跨资产风险偏好，比较偏风险型资产与偏防御型资产的相对表现。

why.en: Confirms whether appetite for risk is broad-based across asset classes, not just concentrated in equities.
why.zh: 用于确认风险偏好是否在各类资产间广泛存在，而不仅局限于股票市场。

basis.en: 0-100 sub-score (0 = fully risk-off, 100 = fully risk-on)
basis.zh: 0-100分项评分（0为完全避险，100为完全风险偏好）

en: Reflects relative performance across assets, not any single asset's absolute level.
Can diverge from equity-only trend factors during narrow, index-led moves.
zh: 反映的是各类资产之间的相对表现，而非单一资产的绝对水平。
在个别指数领涨的窄幅行情中，可能与仅基于股票的趋势因子出现分化。

up.en: High score — risk-seeking assets outperforming defensive ones broadly.
up.zh: 评分较高——偏风险型资产整体跑赢防御型资产。

down.en: Low score — defensive assets outperforming; a risk-off signature.
down.zh: 评分较低——防御型资产跑赢，呈现避险特征。

neutral.en: Mid score — cross-asset signals mixed or offsetting.
neutral.zh: 评分居中——跨资产信号不一致或相互抵消。

en: pullback risk
drawdown radar
zh: 回撤风险
风险雷达

definition.en: A leading advisory score for pullback risk across seven scare types — credit stress, rate shocks, bubble unwind, growth scares, volatility events, and breadth breakdowns.
definition.zh: 针对七类「惊吓」情景（信用压力、利率冲击、泡沫回落、增长担忧、波动率事件、市场广度恶化等）给出的前瞻性回撤风险提示评分。

why.en: Flags rising pullback risk earlier than a lagging drawdown measure, so you can size or hedge before stress becomes visible in price.
why.zh: 相比滞后性的回撤指标能更早提示风险上升，帮助在压力体现到价格之前调整仓位或对冲。

basis.en: Categorical band (calm / watch / caution / elevated / risk-off)
basis.zh: 分类区间（平静／观察／谨慎／偏高／避险）

en: This is a probability-of-pullback advisory, not a certainty or a timing call.
Elevated/caution bands describe sizing context; they do not by themselves override the broader market read.
zh: 这是回撤概率的提示性评分，不是确定性判断或择时信号。
高位/谨慎区间提供的是仓位管理参考，不会单独凌驾于整体市场判断之上。

up.en: Elevated or risk-off — historically higher-than-normal odds of a near-term pullback; a de-risking sizing consideration, not an exit signal.
up.zh: 偏高或避险——历史上意味着近期回撤概率高于平常，属于降低仓位风险的参考，而非清仓信号。

down.en: Calm or watch — no unusual pullback pressure detected among the tracked scare types.
down.zh: 平静或观察——所跟踪的各类「惊吓」情景中未检测到异常回撤压力。

neutral.en: Caution — some scare types are stirring; a reason to tighten risk controls, not to override a supportive market read.
neutral.zh: 谨慎——部分「惊吓」情景出现苗头，提示应收紧风险控制，但不足以推翻整体偏支持性的市场判断。

en: regime stability
settledness
zh: 状态稳定性
象限转换

definition.en: Shows how settled the current regime quadrant is — stable, shifting, weakening, or newly changed.
definition.zh: 显示当前宏观象限的稳定程度——稳定、转换中、走弱，或刚刚切换。

why.en: Tells you how much to trust the current regime read: a stable label can be leaned on, a shifting one calls for lighter positioning.
why.zh: 帮助判断当前象限判断的可信度：稳定状态可作为依据，转换中则应更谨慎地控制仓位。

basis.en: Categorical label (stable / shifting / weakening / new regime)
basis.zh: 分类标签（稳定／转换中／走弱／刚切换）

en: A stable label describes confirmation, not certainty — regimes can and do turn.
A "new regime" label reflects a just-confirmed change and may itself still be tested.
zh: 稳定标签代表确认结果，并非绝对保证——宏观象限仍可能发生转变。
「刚切换」标签代表刚确认的变化，其本身仍可能被后续数据检验。

neutral.en: No directional up/down reading — this describes confidence in the current regime label, not a market direction.
neutral.zh: 无上行／下行方向性判断——该指标描述的是对当前象限标签的可信度，而非市场方向。

en: trend leg
tape trend score
zh: 趋势分项
趋势评分

definition.en: One of six factors feeding the Market State Score: the multi-timeframe price trend of major US equity indexes, from daily through monthly.
definition.zh: 构成市场状态分的六项因子之一：主要美股指数在日线至月线多个周期上的价格趋势。

why.en: Confirms whether the tape's own price action supports the broader market read, weighted toward longer timeframes for durability.
why.zh: 用于确认盘面自身走势是否支持整体市场判断，权重更偏向较长周期以体现持续性。

basis.en: 0-100 sub-score (0 = fully risk-off, 100 = fully risk-on)
basis.zh: 0-100分项评分（0为完全避险，100为完全风险偏好）

en: Weighted toward weekly and monthly timeframes; a strong daily move alone will not move this factor much.
A trend confirmation measure, not a prediction of the trend's continuation.
zh: 权重偏向周线与月线，单日大幅波动对该因子影响有限。
这是对趋势的确认性衡量，不是对趋势能否延续的预测。

up.en: High score — trend broadly aligned bullish across timeframes.
up.zh: 评分较高——各周期趋势总体呈看涨一致。

down.en: Low score — trend broadly aligned bearish across timeframes.
down.zh: 评分较低——各周期趋势总体呈看跌一致。

neutral.en: Mid score — short- and longer-term trends disagree.
neutral.zh: 评分居中——短期与长期趋势不一致。

en: liquidity leg
money-tide score
zh: 流动性分项
资金面评分

definition.en: One of six factors feeding the Market State Score: broad money and credit conditions, sometimes called the "money tide."
definition.zh: 构成市场状态分的六项因子之一：广义货币与信用状况，有时也称为「资金潮汐」。

why.en: Liquidity conditions historically influence how much fuel is available for risk assets to keep rising, independent of price trend alone.
why.zh: 资金面状况历史上会影响风险资产持续上涨的「燃料」是否充足，独立于价格趋势本身。

basis.en: 0-100 sub-score (0 = fully risk-off, 100 = fully risk-on)
basis.zh: 0-100分项评分（0为完全避险，100为完全风险偏好）

en: Liquidity conditions move gradually; large day-to-day swings in this factor are uncommon.
Reflects system-level conditions, not any single fund flow or institution.
zh: 流动性状况变化通常较为缓慢，该因子日间大幅波动的情况并不常见。
反映的是系统层面的整体状况，而非某一资金流或机构的情况。

up.en: High score — liquidity and credit conditions supportive.
up.zh: 评分较高——流动性与信用状况偏支持性。

down.en: Low score — liquidity and credit conditions tightening.
down.zh: 评分较低——流动性与信用状况趋紧。

neutral.en: Mid score — liquidity signals mixed or transitional.
neutral.zh: 评分居中——流动性信号不一致或处于过渡期。

en: plumbing state
liquidity regime
zh: 流动性周期
流动性环境

definition.en: A four-way classification of financial-system liquidity conditions: stress expansion, clean expansion, contraction, or neutral.
definition.zh: 对金融体系流动性状况的四分类判断：压力型扩张、健康型扩张、收缩，或中性。

why.en: Liquidity tends to lift or drag most risk assets together, so knowing the current state helps explain broad market tailwinds or headwinds.
why.zh: 流动性变化往往同步影响多数风险资产，了解当前状态有助于理解市场整体的顺风或逆风环境。

basis.en: Categorical label (stress expansion / clean expansion / contraction / neutral)
basis.zh: 分类标签（压力型扩张／健康型扩张／收缩／中性）

en: Liquidity conditions shift gradually and lag some faster market-moving events.
"Expansion" describes system liquidity, not a guarantee that every asset benefits equally or immediately.
zh: 流动性状况变化通常较为缓慢，可能滞后于部分反应更快的市场事件。
「扩张」描述的是系统整体流动性，不代表所有资产都会同等或立即受益。

up.en: Clean expansion — liquidity growing without unusual stress signatures; generally supportive for risk assets.
up.zh: 健康型扩张——流动性增长且未伴随异常压力特征，总体对风险资产有利。

down.en: Contraction — liquidity shrinking; historically a headwind for risk assets.
down.zh: 收缩——流动性收缩，历史上对风险资产构成逆风。

neutral.en: Stress expansion or neutral — liquidity is growing but alongside stress signals, or showing no clear direction; read with the accompanying context.
neutral.zh: 压力型扩张或中性——流动性在增长但伴随压力信号，或方向不明朗，建议结合具体背景解读。

max drawdown

高点回落

definition.en: The percentage decline from a recent peak value to a subsequent trough, a standard way to measure the depth of a market or portfolio decline.
definition.zh: 从近期高点回落至后续低点的百分比跌幅，是衡量市场或组合下跌深度的常用方式。

why.en: Drawdown size is a plain, comparable way to gauge how severe a given pullback has been relative to history.
why.zh: 回撤幅度是衡量本轮下跌相对历史严重程度的直观、可比较的方式。

basis.en: Percent decline from peak
basis.zh: 相对高点的百分比跌幅

en: Measures a decline that has already happened; it does not predict whether the decline will deepen or recover.
Comparisons across periods should account for differences in overall volatility.
zh: 衡量的是已经发生的跌幅，不能预测跌幅是会进一步加深还是随后回升。
不同时期的回撤比较应考虑整体波动率水平的差异。

neutral.en: No single up/down reading — drawdown is a backward-looking measure of decline already observed, reported as a magnitude.
neutral.zh: 无单一上行／下行判断——回撤是对已发生跌幅的回顾性衡量，以幅度形式呈现。

en: stress leg
drawdown-risk guard
zh: 压力分项
回撤保护评分

definition.en: One of six factors feeding the Market State Score: a drawdown-risk guard measuring acute systemic stress signatures.
definition.zh: 构成市场状态分的六项因子之一：作为回撤风险防护，衡量急性系统性压力特征。

why.en: Designed to catch acute stress conditions quickly, since this factor can cap the overall market read even when other factors look supportive.
why.zh: 旨在快速捕捉急性压力状况，因此即便其他因子表现良好，该因子也可能拉低整体市场判断上限。

basis.en: 0-100 sub-score (0 = fully risk-off, 100 = fully risk-on)
basis.zh: 0-100分项评分（0为完全避险，100为完全风险偏好）

en: Designed to react quickly to acute stress; can move faster than the other five factors.
A current-condition guard, not a forecast of whether stress will worsen.
zh: 该因子对急性压力反应较快，波动速度可能快于其余五项因子。
这是对当前状况的防护性衡量，不是对压力是否会加剧的预测。

up.en: High score — no acute stress signatures detected.
up.zh: 评分较高——未检测到急性压力特征。

down.en: Low score — acute stress signatures present; a defensive signal.

neutral.en: Mid score — stress signals building but not yet acute.
neutral.zh: 评分居中——压力信号正在累积，但尚未达到急性程度。

definition.en: An index measuring the market's expectation of S&P 500 volatility over the next 30 days, derived from options prices; often called the "fear gauge."
definition.zh: 基于期权价格计算的标普500未来30天预期波动率指数，常被称为「恐慌指数」。

why.en: Sharp VIX spikes typically coincide with sudden risk-off moves, while sustained low levels typically coincide with calmer, trending markets.
why.zh: VIX急剧飙升通常与突发性避险行情同时出现，而长期维持低位则通常对应较为平稳、趋势明确的市场。

basis.en: Index level (annualized implied volatility percentage)
basis.zh: 指数点位（年化隐含波动率百分比）

en: Measures expected future volatility implied by options, not volatility that has already occurred.
Extended low readings do not by themselves predict when volatility will rise.
zh: 衡量的是期权隐含的未来预期波动率，而非已经实现的历史波动率。
长期处于低位并不能据此预测波动率何时会上升。

up.en: Rising VIX — rising expected volatility; often coincides with market stress.
up.zh: VIX上升——预期波动率上升，通常与市场压力同时出现。

down.en: Falling VIX — falling expected volatility; often coincides with calmer markets.
down.zh: VIX下降——预期波动率下降，通常与市场趋于平稳同时出现。

neutral.en: VIX roughly stable over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内VIX大致稳定。

volatility regime score

波动率评分

definition.zh: 构成市场状态分的六项因子之一：以隐含波动率期限结构等指标衡量的波动率环境。

why.en: Calm, orderly volatility historically supports risk-taking; spiking or inverted volatility term structure is a caution signal.
why.zh: 平稳有序的波动率环境历史上有利于承担风险；波动率飙升或期限结构倒挂通常是警示信号。

basis.en: 0-100 sub-score (0 = fully risk-off, 100 = fully risk-on)
basis.zh: 0-100分项评分（0为完全避险，100为完全风险偏好）

en: A measured, current-state reading of volatility, not a forecast of a future spike.
Volatility can shift abruptly around scheduled events; check the calendar context.
zh: 这是对当前波动率状态的衡量，不是对未来波动率飙升的预测。
波动率可能在重要事件公布前后出现骤变，建议结合日历事件一并查看。

up.en: High score — volatility low and orderly; supportive backdrop.
up.zh: 评分较高——波动率处于低位且运行有序，环境偏支持性。

down.en: Low score — volatility elevated or term structure stressed.
down.zh: 评分较低——波动率偏高，或期限结构承压。

neutral.en: Mid score — volatility signals transitional or mixed.
neutral.zh: 评分居中——波动率信号处于过渡期或不一致。

en: vol term structure
volatility state

definition.en: A broader read of the current volatility environment, including whether implied volatility for near-term options sits above or below longer-dated options.
definition.zh: 对当前波动率环境的更全面判断，包括近月期权隐含波动率是否高于或低于远月期权。

why.en: An inverted term structure (near-term volatility above longer-term) often signals acute near-term stress rather than a durable volatility regime shift.
why.zh: 波动率期限结构倒挂（近月高于远月）通常意味着短期急性压力，而非波动率环境的持久性转变。

basis.en: Categorical / relative comparison across option expirations
basis.zh: 分类／不同到期期权之间的相对比较

en: Term-structure inversions can resolve quickly once the triggering event passes.
Describes options-market pricing, not a forecast of realized future volatility.
zh: 期限结构倒挂在触发事件消退后往往会较快恢复正常。
反映的是期权市场定价，不是对未来实际波动率的预测。

up.en: Elevated / inverted — near-term stress dominating; historically a caution signal.
up.zh: 偏高／倒挂——近期压力主导，历史上属于谨慎信号。

down.en: Low / normal upward-sloping — calmer, more typical volatility conditions.
down.zh: 偏低／正常向上倾斜——波动率环境更为平稳、典型。

neutral.en: Volatility term structure roughly flat or transitional.
neutral.zh: 波动率期限结构大致走平或处于过渡期。

en: breakeven rate
TIPS breakeven
zh: 通胀预期
平衡通胀率

definition.en: The market-implied average inflation rate over a given period, derived from the yield gap between a nominal bond and its inflation-protected equivalent.
definition.zh: 市场隐含的某一期限内平均通胀预期，通过普通债券与对应通胀保值债券之间的收益率差计算得出。

why.en: Gives a real-time, market-based read on inflation expectations, distinct from surveys or economist forecasts.
why.zh: 提供基于市场定价的实时通胀预期读数，区别于调查或经济学家预测。

basis.en: Percent (implied annual inflation rate)
basis.zh: 百分比（隐含年化通胀率）

en: Reflects market pricing, which can be distorted by liquidity or technical factors in the underlying bond markets, not only genuine inflation views.
A market expectation, not a guarantee of realized future inflation.
zh: 反映的是市场定价，可能受相关债券市场流动性或技术性因素影响，并非纯粹的通胀判断。
这是市场预期，不保证未来实际通胀会与之一致。

up.en: Rising breakevens — market pricing in higher future inflation.
up.zh: 盈亏平衡通胀率上升——市场正在计入更高的未来通胀预期。

down.en: Falling breakevens — market pricing in lower future inflation.
down.zh: 盈亏平衡通胀率下降——市场正在计入更低的未来通胀预期。

neutral.en: Breakevens roughly stable over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内盈亏平衡通胀率大致稳定。

bear flattener

平坦化

definition.en: Describes how the gap between short- and long-dated bond yields is changing — widening (steepening) or narrowing (flattening) — and whether it is driven mainly by short or long rates moving.
definition.zh: 描述短期与长期债券收益率之差如何变化——扩大（陡峭化）或缩小（平坦化）——以及主要是由短端还是长端利率变动驱动。

why.en: The combination of steepening/flattening with rising/falling rates carries different economic implications, from growth optimism to recession fears.
why.zh: 陡峭化／平坦化与利率上行／下行的不同组合，通常对应不同的经济含义，从对增长乐观到对衰退的担忧不等。

basis.en: Change in spread between two maturities, in basis points
basis.zh: 两个期限之间利差的变化，以基点计

en: The same steepening or flattening move can carry opposite implications depending on whether short or long rates are driving it.
Short-term noise in bond markets can create moves that reverse quickly.
zh: 相同的陡峭化或平坦化走势，其经济含义可能因驱动力来自短端还是长端而截然不同。
债券市场的短期波动可能导致该走势迅速逆转。

up.en: Steepening — the spread between long and short yields is widening.
up.zh: 陡峭化——长短端收益率利差正在扩大。

down.en: Flattening — the spread between long and short yields is narrowing.
down.zh: 平坦化——长短端收益率利差正在收窄。

neutral.en: Little change in the spread over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内利差变化不大。

en: inflation-adjusted yield
TIPS yield
zh: 通胀调整后利率

definition.en: A bond yield after subtracting expected inflation — the actual purchasing-power return an investor expects to earn.
definition.zh: 扣除预期通胀后的债券收益率——投资者实际预期获得的购买力回报。

why.en: Rising real rates raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding or long-duration assets, and have historically pressured segments like gold and long-duration growth stocks.
why.zh: 实际利率上升会提高持有无息或长久期资产的机会成本，历史上通常对黄金及长久期成长股等板块构成压力。

basis.en: Percent (nominal yield minus breakeven inflation)
basis.zh: 百分比（名义收益率减去盈亏平衡通胀率）

en: Derived from market-based inflation expectations, which can themselves be noisy or distorted by liquidity conditions.
Relationships with other assets are historical tendencies, not fixed rules.
zh: 该指标基于市场隐含的通胀预期计算，而通胀预期本身可能受流动性等因素扰动。
与其他资产的关系属于历史经验规律，并非固定法则。

up.en: Rising real rates — higher opportunity cost for non-yielding/long-duration assets.
up.zh: 实际利率上升——无息资产及长久期资产的机会成本上升。

down.en: Falling real rates — lower opportunity cost; historically supportive for gold and long-duration assets.
down.zh: 实际利率下降——机会成本降低，历史上对黄金及长久期资产构成支撑。

neutral.en: Real rates roughly flat over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内实际利率大致持平。

definition.en: The extra yield investors demand for holding a longer-maturity bond instead of rolling over a series of shorter-maturity ones, compensating for extra risk and uncertainty over time.
definition.zh: 投资者持有长期债券而非滚动持有一系列短期债券所要求的额外收益，用以补偿更长时间内承担的额外风险与不确定性。

why.en: A rising term premium can push long-end yields higher even if growth and inflation expectations are unchanged, a distinct driver worth separating out.
why.zh: 期限溢价上升可能在增长与通胀预期不变的情况下单独推高长端收益率，是值得区分开来看的独立驱动因素。

basis.en: Percent (estimated component of long-dated yields)
basis.zh: 百分比（长端收益率中的估算组成部分）

en: An estimated, model-derived quantity rather than a directly observable market price; different models can disagree.
Should be read alongside growth and inflation expectations, not in isolation.
zh: 该指标属于模型估算值，而非可直接观察的市场价格，不同模型的估算结果可能存在差异。
建议结合增长与通胀预期一并解读，不宜单独使用。

up.en: Rising term premium — investors demanding more compensation to hold long-dated debt.
up.zh: 期限溢价上升——投资者要求更高补偿以持有长期债券。

down.en: Falling term premium — investors demanding less compensation for holding long-dated debt.
down.zh: 期限溢价下降——投资者要求的持有长期债券补偿降低。

neutral.en: Term premium roughly stable over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内期限溢价大致稳定。

definition.en: A chart of government bond yields across maturities; "inverted" means shorter-dated yields sit above longer-dated ones, the reverse of the usual upward-sloping shape.
definition.zh: 不同期限政府债券收益率的走势图；「倒挂」指短期收益率高于长期收益率，与通常向上倾斜的正常形态相反。

why.en: An inverted curve has historically preceded many past US recessions, though with variable and sometimes long lead times.
why.zh: 收益率曲线倒挂历史上曾出现在多次美国经济衰退之前，但领先时间长短不一，有时较长。

basis.en: Percent yield by maturity; spread in basis points (e.g. 2s10s)
basis.zh: 按期限计的收益率百分比；利差以基点计（如2年10年利差）

en: An inversion is a historical statistical association with recessions, not a fixed rule, and the lead time before any downturn has varied widely.
Curve shape can be affected by policy actions and technical factors, not only growth or inflation expectations.
zh: 曲线倒挂与经济衰退之间是历史上的统计关联，并非确定性规律，且领先时间差异很大。
曲线形态也可能受政策操作及技术性因素影响，并非只反映增长或通胀预期。

up.en: Steepening / normalizing — curve reverting to its usual upward slope.
up.zh: 陡峭化／正常化——曲线正回归通常的向上倾斜形态。

down.en: Inverting further — short-dated yields rising above long-dated yields.
down.zh: 倒挂加深——短期收益率进一步升至长期收益率之上。

neutral.en: Flat curve — little difference between short- and long-dated yields.
neutral.zh: 曲线走平——短期与长期收益率差距很小。

definition.en: The extra yield a corporate bond pays over a comparable-maturity government bond, compensating investors for default and liquidity risk.
definition.zh: 企业债相对于同期限政府债券支付的额外收益，用于补偿投资者所承担的违约风险与流动性风险。

why.en: Widening spreads signal rising perceived credit risk and tend to coincide with broader risk-off conditions across markets.
why.zh: 利差走阔通常意味着市场感知的信用风险上升，往往与更广泛的市场避险情绪同时出现。

basis.en: Basis points over a comparable government bond yield
basis.zh: 相对同期限政府债券收益率的基点利差

en: Spreads reflect perceived risk at a point in time and can move ahead of, or lag, actual default outcomes.
Liquidity conditions in the bond market itself can widen spreads independent of credit quality.
zh: 利差反映的是某一时点市场感知的风险，可能领先或滞后于实际违约情况。
债券市场自身的流动性状况也可能推高利差，未必与信用质量变化相关。

up.en: Widening spread — rising perceived credit risk; historically a risk-off signal.
up.zh: 利差走阔——市场感知的信用风险上升，历史上属于避险信号。

down.en: Narrowing spread — falling perceived credit risk; historically a risk-on signal.
down.zh: 利差收窄——市场感知的信用风险下降，历史上属于风险偏好信号。

neutral.en: Spread roughly stable over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内利差大致稳定。

definition.en: The credit spread specifically on below-investment-grade ("high-yield" or "junk") corporate bonds — a widely watched gauge of stress in riskier credit markets.
definition.zh: 专指投资级以下（「高收益」或「垃圾」级）企业债的信用利差——是衡量较高风险信用市场压力的常用指标。

why.en: High-yield borrowers are typically the first to feel funding stress, so this spread often widens earlier and more sharply than investment-grade spreads.
why.zh: 高收益债发行人通常最先感受到融资压力，因此该利差往往比投资级利差更早、更大幅度地走阔。

basis.en: Basis points over a comparable government bond yield
basis.zh: 相对同期限政府债券收益率的基点利差

en: Can be more volatile than investment-grade spreads and swing on liquidity as well as credit fundamentals.
A market-based stress gauge, not a direct measure of actual default rates.
zh: 波动性通常高于投资级利差，除信用基本面外也会受流动性因素影响。
这是基于市场定价的压力指标，并非实际违约率的直接度量。

up.en: Widening spread — rising stress among lower-rated borrowers; a risk-off signal.
up.zh: 利差走阔——低评级发行人压力上升，属于避险信号。

down.en: Narrowing spread — improving conditions for lower-rated borrowers; a risk-on signal.
down.zh: 利差收窄——低评级发行人状况改善，属于风险偏好信号。

neutral.en: Spread roughly stable over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内利差大致稳定。

definition.zh: 构成市场状态分的六项因子之一：衡量个股参与本轮行情的广泛程度，而非仅看指数表现。

why.en: A strong index move with weak breadth is a classic warning sign that the rally is narrow and more fragile than it looks.
why.zh: 指数上涨但广度偏弱是典型的警示信号，说明涨势较为集中，比表面看起来更脆弱。

basis.en: 0-100 sub-score (0 = fully risk-off, 100 = fully risk-on)
basis.zh: 0-100分项评分（0为完全避险，100为完全风险偏好）

en: A snapshot of current participation, not a guarantee that narrow breadth will resolve into a reversal.
Best read alongside the trend factor rather than in isolation.
zh: 该指标反映当前参与度快照，广度偏弱不代表必然出现反转。
建议与趋势因子结合查看，避免单独解读。

up.en: High score — participation broad across stocks; a healthier move.
up.zh: 评分较高——个股参与广泛，行情较为健康。

down.en: Low score — participation narrow; a warning on move durability.
down.zh: 评分较低——参与度狭窄，对行情持续性发出警示。

neutral.en: Mid score — breadth improving or deteriorating, not yet decisive.
neutral.zh: 评分居中——广度正在改善或恶化，方向尚未明确。

definition.en: A view of which sectors or factors have been taking over the lead from others recently, showing rotation over time.
definition.zh: 展示近期哪些板块或风格因子正在接替领涨地位，反映资金轮动的变化。

why.en: Rotation between leaders can be an early sign that the market's preferences are shifting.
why.zh: 领涨板块之间的轮动，可能是市场偏好正在转变的早期迹象。

basis.en: Ranked change in relative leadership over recent windows
basis.zh: 近期窗口内相对领涨地位排名的变化

en: This describes recent rotation, not a forecast of future leadership, and it is not a recommendation to buy or sell any sector or factor.
zh: 这描述的是近期的轮动情况，并非对未来领涨格局的预测，也不构成任何买卖建议。

up.en: A new leader emerging suggests a possible shift in market preference.
up.zh: 出现新的领涨板块，可能意味着市场偏好正在转变。

down.en: A former leader fading suggests that theme may be losing momentum.
down.zh: 此前的领涨板块走弱，可能意味着该主题的动能正在减弱。

neutral.en: Stable leadership with little rotation is common in steady, trending markets.
neutral.zh: 在稳定的趋势性市场中，领涨地位保持稳定、轮动较少的情况较为常见。

definition.en: A measure of how many individual stocks are participating in a market move, as opposed to the move being driven by a small number of large stocks.
definition.zh: 衡量有多少只个股参与本轮市场行情，而非行情主要由少数大盘股驱动。

why.en: Narrow breadth behind a rising index is a classic warning sign that a rally may be more fragile than the headline number suggests.
why.zh: 指数上涨但广度狭窄是典型警示信号，说明涨势可能比指数表面表现更脆弱。

basis.en: Descriptive / ratio-based (e.g. advancing vs declining issues)
basis.zh: 描述性／基于比率（如上涨与下跌家数对比）

en: Narrow breadth does not by itself predict when or whether a reversal will occur.
Different breadth measures (advance-decline, new highs/lows, cap-weighted vs equal-weighted) can occasionally disagree.
zh: 广度狭窄本身并不能预测反转是否会发生或何时发生。
不同广度衡量方式（涨跌家数、新高新低、市值加权与等权对比）之间有时会出现分歧。

up.en: Broadening — more stocks participating in the move; historically a healthier signal.
up.zh: 广度扩大——更多个股参与本轮行情，历史上属于更健康的信号。

down.en: Narrowing — fewer stocks participating; historically a warning sign.
down.zh: 广度收窄——参与行情的个股减少，历史上属于警示信号。

neutral.en: Breadth roughly stable over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内广度大致稳定。

definition.en: A strip of sector tiles colored by recent relative performance, so the strongest and weakest sectors stand out visually.
definition.zh: 一排按近期相对表现着色的板块方块，使表现最强与最弱的板块直观突出。

why.en: It shows which parts of the market are currently leading or lagging, which is useful context for where strength is concentrated.
why.zh: 展示当前市场中哪些板块领先或落后，有助于了解强势资金的集中方向。

basis.en: Relative performance rank per sector, colour-coded
basis.zh: 各板块相对表现排名，以颜色区分

en: This shows recent relative performance, not a forecast of which sector will lead next, and it is not a recommendation to buy or sell any sector.
zh: 这展示的是近期相对表现，并非对下一阶段领涨板块的预测，也不构成任何买卖建议。

up.en: A hot sector has been outperforming the broader market recently.
up.zh: 热力较高的板块近期跑赢大盘。

down.en: A cold sector has been underperforming the broader market recently.
down.zh: 热力较低的板块近期跑输大盘。

neutral.en: A broadly even strip means leadership is not currently concentrated in a few sectors.
neutral.zh: 若各板块热力较为均匀，说明当前领涨力量并未集中在少数板块。

terms.search: sectorheat板块热力sectorheat

definition.en: A chip flagging that a company insider has recently reported buying shares in the open market.
definition.zh: 一个标签，标记公司内部人近期披露在公开市场买入股票。

why.en: Insider buying can be a data point worth noting alongside everything else you already look at, since insiders sometimes have informed views on their own company.
why.zh: 内部人买入行为可以作为一项值得留意的数据点，因为内部人有时对自家公司持有更为了解的判断。

basis.en: Presence/absence flag from recent public insider filings
basis.zh: 来自近期公开内部人披露记录的有无标记

en: This reflects public regulatory filings only and is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or size anything.
zh: 该数据仅反映公开监管披露信息，不构成任何买入、卖出或仓位建议。

up.en: A recent insider buy has been reported for this name.
up.zh: 该股票近期有内部人披露买入。

down.en: No recent insider buy has been reported for this name.
down.zh: 该股票近期没有内部人披露买入。

neutral.en: Absence of a reported buy does not itself mean anything negative — most names have no insider activity most of the time.
neutral.zh: 没有内部人披露买入本身并不代表负面信号——大多数股票在大多数时间都没有内部人交易活动。

en: investor positioning
futures positioning
zh: 投资者持仓
期货持仓

definition.en: How exposed investors currently are to a given market or theme — for example, how crowded a trade has become relative to its own history.
definition.zh: 投资者当前对某一市场或主题的敞口程度——例如某一交易相对其自身历史而言拥挤程度如何。

why.en: Extremely crowded positioning can make a market more vulnerable to sharp reversals when sentiment shifts, even without a change in fundamentals.
why.zh: 持仓过度拥挤可能使市场在情绪转变时更容易出现剧烈反转，即便基本面并未发生变化。

basis.en: Descriptive / relative to historical positioning ranges
basis.zh: 描述性／相对历史持仓区间

en: Publicly available positioning data is often reported with a lag and does not capture every market participant.
Extreme positioning can persist for extended periods before it reverses.
zh: 公开可得的持仓数据通常存在滞后，且无法覆盖所有市场参与者。
极端持仓状态可能持续较长时间才会发生反转。

up.en: Positioning stretched long — potentially more vulnerable to a downside reversal.
up.zh: 持仓过度偏多——可能更容易出现下行反转。

down.en: Positioning stretched short — potentially more vulnerable to a squeeze higher.
down.zh: 持仓过度偏空——可能更容易出现逼空式上行反转。

neutral.en: Positioning roughly balanced relative to its own history.
neutral.zh: 持仓相对自身历史大致均衡。

en: standardized unexpected earnings
zh: 标准化未预期盈余

definition.en: A chip showing how far a company's reported earnings deviated from analyst expectations, scaled to be comparable across companies.
definition.zh: 一个标签，显示公司公布的盈余与分析师预期的偏离程度，并按可比口径进行了标准化处理。

why.en: A large surprise in either direction can be a meaningful event for a stock in the days around its earnings report.
why.zh: 无论方向如何，较大的盈余意外通常是该股票财报前后值得关注的重要事件。

basis.en: Standardized surprise score relative to analyst estimates
basis.zh: 相对于分析师预期的标准化意外分数

en: This describes a past reported result, not a forecast of the next report, and it is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or size anything.
zh: 这描述的是已公布的历史结果，并非对下一次财报的预测，也不构成任何买卖建议。

up.en: A positive surprise means reported earnings came in above analyst expectations.
up.zh: 正向意外表示公布的盈余高于分析师预期。

down.en: A negative surprise means reported earnings came in below analyst expectations.
down.zh: 负向意外表示公布的盈余低于分析师预期。

neutral.en: A surprise near zero means results were broadly in line with expectations.
neutral.zh: 接近零的意外值表示业绩基本符合预期。

terms.search: earningssurprisesue盈余惊喜suesueearningssurprisestandardizedunexpectedearnings标准化未预期盈余

definition.en: A chip summarising how a factor or sector has historically tended to perform during the current calendar window, based on past years.
definition.zh: 一个标签，基于历史年份数据，概括某一风格因子或板块在当前日历窗口通常的表现倾向。

why.en: It adds calendar-based historical context, which is one input among many rather than a standalone reason to act.
why.zh: 它提供了基于日历的历史背景信息，属于众多参考因素之一，而非单独的行动依据。

basis.en: Historical average seasonal tendency over past calendar windows
basis.zh: 过去日历窗口内的历史平均季节性倾向

en: This is a historical seasonal tendency, not a forecast, and it is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or size anything.
zh: 这是一种历史季节性倾向，并非预测，也不构成任何买入、卖出或仓位建议。

up.en: A historically favourable seasonal window for this factor or sector.
up.zh: 该风格因子或板块历史上在此日历窗口表现相对有利。

down.en: A historically unfavourable seasonal window for this factor or sector.
down.zh: 该风格因子或板块历史上在此日历窗口表现相对不利。

neutral.en: A neutral seasonal read means history shows no strong tendency either way.
neutral.zh: 中性的季节性读数表示历史数据未显示出明显的偏向。

terms.search: factorseasonalitychip因子季节性标签factorseasonality

en: key release
market-moving event
zh: 重要数据
关键事件

definition.en: A scheduled economic release, central bank decision, or other calendar event judged likely to move markets, shown with its exact time and source.
definition.zh: 被判断为可能对市场产生较大影响的经济数据公布、央行决议或其他日历事件，附带具体时间与来源。

why.en: Lets you plan around known catalysts in advance, rather than being surprised by volatility around a scheduled release.
why.zh: 可提前围绕已知催化事件做规划，避免在既定数据公布时被突发波动打乱节奏。

basis.en: Scheduled calendar entry with exact time and source
basis.zh: 附带具体时间与来源的日历事项

en: Being on the calendar means the event is judged likely to matter; it does not predict the direction of any market reaction.
Times and scope can change; always confirm against the original source close to the event.
zh: 列入日历代表该事件被判断为重要，但不代表能预测市场反应的方向。
时间与范围可能变动，临近事件时请以原始来源确认为准。

neutral.en: No directional reading — this marks a scheduled event, not a market call.
neutral.zh: 无方向性判断——该标记的是既定日历事件，而非市场判断。

terms.search: highimpactevent高影响力事件highimpacteventkeyreleasemarketmovingevent重要数据关键事件

en: quarter-end rebalance
index rebalancing
zh: 季末再平衡
指数调仓

definition.en: Mechanical buying and selling by index funds and large asset allocators around quarter-end, driven by target weights rather than views on individual securities.
definition.zh: 指数基金及大型资产配置机构在季末前后，为达到目标权重而进行的机械性买卖，其驱动因素是权重目标而非对个别证券的判断。

why.en: Can temporarily distort price and volume patterns near quarter-end, unrelated to fundamentals or sentiment.
why.zh: 可能在季末前后暂时扭曲价格与成交量模式，与基本面或市场情绪无关。

basis.en: Calendar window (typically final trading days of a quarter)
basis.zh: 日历窗口（通常为季度最后几个交易日）

en: Flow direction depends on relative performance since the last rebalance, and is not published in advance with certainty.
Effects are typically short-lived and can reverse quickly after the window closes.
zh: 资金流方向取决于上次再平衡以来的相对表现，事前难以完全确定。
相关影响通常较为短暂，窗口结束后可能迅速逆转。

neutral.en: No directional reading — rebalance flow is a mechanical event, not a market signal.
neutral.zh: 无方向性判断——再平衡资金流是机械性事件，而非市场信号。

en: data surprise
forecast skew
zh: 超预期偏向
预测偏差

definition.en: Whether an economic release is likely to land cooler, in line, or hotter than the consensus forecast, based on available leading indicators.
definition.zh: 基于可获得的领先指标，判断某项经济数据公布结果相对市场一致预期偏冷、符合预期，还是偏热。

why.en: Helps set expectations ahead of a release, so the eventual market reaction is easier to interpret in context.
why.zh: 有助于在数据公布前设定预期，便于结合背景理解公布后的市场反应。

basis.en: Categorical skew (cooler / inline / hotter)
basis.zh: 分类偏向（偏冷／符合预期／偏热）

en: A pre-release lean based on available indicators, not the actual release result.
Markets can still react unexpectedly even when the release matches the skew.
zh: 这是公布前基于现有指标的倾向判断，并非实际公布结果。
即便公布结果符合该偏向，市场反应仍可能超出预期。

up.en: Hotter skew — leading indicators point above consensus; may pressure rate-sensitive assets if realized.
up.zh: 偏热——领先指标指向高于市场一致预期，若兑现可能对利率敏感资产构成压力。

down.en: Cooler skew — leading indicators point below consensus; may support rate-sensitive assets if realized.
down.zh: 偏冷——领先指标指向低于市场一致预期，若兑现可能对利率敏感资产形成支撑。

neutral.en: Inline skew — leading indicators broadly agree with consensus.
neutral.zh: 符合预期——领先指标与市场一致预期总体相符。

definition.en: A score summarising how many of a checklist of technical conditions a stock currently satisfies.
definition.zh: 一项分数，概括个股当前满足了多少项技术条件清单。

why.en: It condenses a checklist into a single readout so you do not have to check every condition by hand.
why.zh: 将一份检查清单浓缩为单一读数，省去逐项人工核对的步骤。

basis.en: Count of checklist conditions satisfied, out of a fixed total
basis.zh: 满足的检查清单条件数量（占固定总数的比例）

en: This explains what the marker means. It is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or size anything.
The checklist is a technical read of price and volume history, not a forecast of future returns.
zh: 此处只说明该标记的含义，不构成任何买入、卖出或仓位建议。
该清单是对价格与成交量历史的技术性解读，并非对未来回报的预测。

up.en: A higher score means more of the checklist conditions are currently satisfied.
up.zh: 分数越高，表示满足的检查清单条件越多。

down.en: A lower score means fewer of the checklist conditions are currently satisfied.
down.zh: 分数越低，表示满足的检查清单条件越少。

neutral.en: A mid-range score means the setup is partial rather than clearly present or absent.
neutral.zh: 中等分数表示形态条件部分满足，既非明确具备，也非完全不具备。

terms.search: buyreadinesssetupscore买入准备度形态分buyreadiness

en: confidence level
confidence meter
zh: 信心等级
把握程度

definition.en: A high / medium / low rating showing how firmly a briefing's read holds, based on how well the underlying signals agree.
definition.zh: 高／中／低三档评级，反映简报解读的把握程度，取决于底层信号之间的一致性。

why.en: Tells you how much weight to put on a given read — a low-confidence read calls for more independent verification before acting.
why.zh: 提示应赋予该判断多大的权重——置信度较低时，行动前更需要独立核实。

basis.en: Categorical tier (high / medium / low)
basis.zh: 分类等级（高／中／低）

en: A high-confidence tier reflects signal agreement, not a guarantee of a correct call.
Confidence can change quickly as underlying signals move.
zh: 高置信度反映的是信号间的一致性，并不保证判断结果一定正确。
随底层信号变化，置信度可能迅速调整。

neutral.en: No directional reading — this rates certainty of a read, not market direction.
neutral.zh: 无方向性判断——该指标衡量的是判断的确定性，而非市场方向。

terms.search: confidencetier置信度confidencetierconfidencelevelconfidencemeter信心等级把握程度

definition.en: A small dot indicating whether current price action looks like a typical early-stage setup, based on a fixed technical checklist.
definition.zh: 一个小圆点，基于固定的技术检查清单，指示当前价格走势是否呈现出典型的早期形态特征。

why.en: It flags a specific technical pattern in the price history for you to look at more closely if you choose to.
why.zh: 它标记出价格历史中的一种特定技术形态，供你在需要时进一步查看。

basis.en: Categorical dot state from a fixed technical checklist
basis.zh: 基于固定技术检查清单得出的分类圆点状态

en: This explains what the marker means. It is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or size anything.
This is a technical pattern read, not a forecast of future price direction.
zh: 此处只说明该标记的含义，不构成任何买入、卖出或仓位建议。
这是一种技术形态解读，并非对未来价格方向的预测。

up.en: A lit dot means the current pattern matches the checklist's early-stage criteria.
up.zh: 圆点点亮表示当前形态符合清单中的早期阶段标准。

down.en: An unlit dot means the current pattern does not currently match those criteria.
down.zh: 圆点未点亮表示当前形态尚不符合上述标准。

neutral.en: The dot describes pattern shape only and carries no view on direction by itself.
neutral.zh: 该圆点仅描述形态特征，本身不包含方向性判断。

terms.search: entrytimingdot入场时机点entrytiming

en: where signals disagree
signal tension
zh: 信号张力
信号矛盾

definition.en: When two or more market indicators point in different directions at the same time, shown as a "note" (minor) or "tension" (more significant) severity.
definition.zh: 指两个或以上市场指标在同一时间给出不同方向的判断，按严重程度分为「提示」（较轻微）与「张力」（较显著）两级。

why.en: Divergence is a flag to slow down: acting on one signal while ignoring a conflicting one raises the odds of being wrong-footed.
why.zh: 信号分歧提示应更谨慎：只依据其中一个信号而忽略相互矛盾的另一个，容易导致判断失误。

basis.en: Categorical severity (note / tension)
basis.zh: 分类严重程度（提示／张力）

en: Divergence does not by itself say which signal will prove correct.
A "tension" flag calls for more caution, not automatically a change in position.
zh: 信号分歧本身并不能说明最终哪个信号会被验证正确。
「张力」级别的分歧提示应更加谨慎，但并不意味着必须立即改变仓位。

neutral.en: No single up/down reading — divergence describes disagreement between signals, and its resolution can go either direction.
neutral.zh: 无单一上行／下行判断——信号分歧描述的是信号之间的不一致，其最终解决方向可能是任一方向。

en: what to do
action vocabulary
zh: 应对等级
行动建议用语

definition.en: The briefing's four-word action vocabulary, from calmest to most urgent: ignore, stand-aside, protect, act — describing posture, never a specific trade.
definition.zh: 简报使用的四级应对用语，由平静到紧急依次为：忽略、观望、保护、行动——描述的是姿态，而非具体交易指令。

why.en: Gives a consistent, plain-word scale for how seriously to treat a given read, so urgency is comparable across different briefings and days.
why.zh: 提供统一、直白的分级标准，帮助判断某一判断的紧迫程度，使不同简报、不同日期之间具备可比性。

basis.en: Categorical ladder (ignore / stand-aside / protect / act)
basis.zh: 分类等级（忽略／观望／保护／行动）

en: Describes posture and urgency only; it is never a specific instruction to buy or sell any security.
"Act" signals urgency to review, not a predetermined action.
zh: 仅描述姿态与紧迫程度，绝非针对具体证券的买卖指令。
「行动」级别提示应尽快复核，而非预先设定的具体操作。

neutral.en: No up/down reading — this is a vocabulary of posture, not a market direction.
neutral.zh: 无上行／下行判断——这是一套姿态用语，而非市场方向指标。

en: asset correlation
cross-asset correlation
zh: 资产相关性
跨资产相关性

definition.en: How closely different assets or stocks are moving together, and whether that relationship is currently tighter (higher correlation) or looser (lower correlation) than usual.
definition.zh: 不同资产或个股之间同向变动的紧密程度，以及当前该相关性相较平常是偏高还是偏低。

why.en: Rising correlations reduce the benefit of diversification, since more assets tend to move together during periods of stress.
why.zh: 相关性上升会削弱分散配置的效果，因为压力时期更多资产往往同向变动。

basis.en: Correlation coefficient or relative descriptor (high / normal / low)
basis.zh: 相关系数或相对描述（高／正常／低）

en: Correlation is measured over a historical window and can shift quickly around major market events.
High correlation does not itself indicate direction — only that assets are moving together.
zh: 相关性基于历史窗口计算，在重大市场事件前后可能迅速变化。
相关性偏高本身并不能说明方向，只说明资产之间同向变动的程度。

up.en: Rising correlation — assets moving more together; diversification benefit reduced.
up.zh: 相关性上升——资产同向变动增多，分散配置效果减弱。

down.en: Falling correlation — assets moving more independently; diversification benefit improved.
down.zh: 相关性下降——资产变动更趋独立，分散配置效果提升。

neutral.en: Correlation roughly typical for the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内相关性大致处于常态水平。

en: DXY
USD index
trade-weighted dollar

美元汇率指数

definition.en: A measure of the US dollar's value against a basket of major foreign currencies, widely used as a shorthand for overall dollar strength or weakness.
definition.zh: 衡量美元相对一篮子主要外币价值的指标，常被用作衡量美元整体强弱的简便参考。

why.en: A stronger dollar tends to tighten global financial conditions and can pressure commodities and emerging markets; a weaker dollar tends to ease them.
why.zh: 美元走强通常会收紧全球金融条件，并对大宗商品及新兴市场构成压力；美元走弱则通常起到缓解作用。

basis.en: Index level (relative, no fixed unit)
basis.zh: 指数点位（相对值，无固定单位）

en: The basket is weighted toward a handful of major currencies and does not capture every bilateral dollar relationship.
Relationships with other assets are historical tendencies, not fixed rules.
zh: 该指数篮子权重集中于少数主要货币，无法反映美元对所有货币的双边情况。
与其他资产的关系属于历史经验规律，并非固定法则。

up.en: Rising — dollar strengthening; historically a headwind for commodities and EM assets.
up.zh: 上升——美元走强，历史上对大宗商品及新兴市场资产构成逆风。

down.en: Falling — dollar weakening; historically supportive for commodities and EM assets.
down.zh: 下降——美元走弱，历史上对大宗商品及新兴市场资产构成支撑。

neutral.en: Index roughly flat over the period observed.
neutral.zh: 观察期内指数大致持平。

definition.en: A small chip showing a stock's recent return in excess of what the broader market's move alone would explain.
definition.zh: 一个小标签，显示个股近期回报中超出大盘整体走势可解释部分的部分。

why.en: It separates a stock's own performance from moves that simply tracked the overall market.
why.zh: 有助于区分个股自身的表现与单纯跟随大盘走势带来的收益。

basis.en: Excess return versus a market benchmark, percent
basis.zh: 相对于市场基准的超额回报，百分比表示

en: This is a backward-looking measure of past excess return, not a forecast, and it is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or size anything.
zh: 这是对过去超额回报的回顾性度量，并非预测，也不构成任何买入、卖出或仓位建议。

up.en: A positive value means the stock has outperformed the broader market recently.
up.zh: 正值表示该股票近期跑赢大盘。

down.en: A negative value means the stock has underperformed the broader market recently.
down.zh: 负值表示该股票近期跑输大盘。

neutral.en: A value near zero means the stock has moved roughly in line with the market.
neutral.zh: 接近零的数值表示该股票走势与大盘大致同步。

en: safe-haven flow
flight to safety
zh: 避险情绪
避险买盘

definition.en: A shift of investor capital into perceived safer assets — such as government bonds, the dollar, or gold — typically during periods of market stress.
definition.zh: 投资者资金转向被认为更安全的资产（如政府债券、美元或黄金），通常发生在市场承压时期。

why.en: Recognizing a flight-to-quality move helps explain simultaneous declines in risk assets alongside rallies in traditional safe havens.
why.zh: 识别避险资金流有助于理解为何风险资产下跌的同时，传统避险资产往往同步上涨。

basis.en: Descriptive / observed cross-asset pattern
basis.zh: 描述性／观察到的跨资产模式

en: Which assets act as "safe havens" can shift over time and across episodes.
A descriptive pattern, not a rule that safe havens always rise during stress.
zh: 被视为「避险资产」的具体品种可能随时间及具体事件而变化。
这是描述性模式，并不意味着避险资产在每次压力事件中都必然上涨。

neutral.en: No single up/down reading — this describes a pattern of capital movement, most relevant during risk-off episodes.
neutral.zh: 无单一上行／下行判断——该指标描述的是资金流动模式，在避险时期最具参考意义。

definition.en: A table showing the same set of assets across several time windows (for example a day, a week, and a month) side by side.
definition.zh: 一张表格，将同一批资产在多个时间窗口（例如一日、一周、一月）的表现并排展示。

why.en: It helps separate a short-lived wiggle from a move that is showing up across multiple timeframes at once.
why.zh: 有助于区分短暂波动与在多个周期上同时出现的持续走势。

basis.en: Percent change per asset per timeframe
basis.zh: 按资产与周期划分的涨跌幅百分比

en: This is a descriptive price table, not a ranking or a buy/sell signal.
zh: 这是一张描述性的价格表格，并非排名或买卖信号。

up.en: Consistent direction across timeframes suggests a more established move.
up.zh: 各周期方向一致，通常代表趋势更为确立。

down.en: A short-term move that disagrees with longer timeframes may be noise.
down.zh: 短周期表现与更长周期相悖时，可能只是短期噪音。

neutral.en: Mixed signs across timeframes are common in choppy, range-bound markets.
neutral.zh: 在震荡整理的市场中，各周期方向不一致的情况较为常见。

en: RORO
risk sentiment
zh: 风险开关
风险情绪

definition.en: A shorthand for whether investors are broadly favouring riskier assets (risk-on) or broadly seeking safety (risk-off) across markets at the same time.
definition.zh: 简明描述投资者在同一时期是普遍偏向风险资产（风险偏好）还是普遍寻求避险资产（避险）的用语。

why.en: Recognizing the prevailing risk sentiment helps explain why many unrelated assets can move together on the same day.
why.zh: 识别当前主导的风险情绪，有助于理解为何看似无关的多类资产会在同一天同向变动。

basis.en: Categorical (risk-on / risk-off / mixed)
basis.zh: 分类（风险偏好／避险／混合）

en: A descriptive label for observed cross-asset behaviour, not a predictive signal.
Individual assets can still diverge from the broad label for idiosyncratic reasons.
zh: 这是对已观察到的跨资产行为的描述性标签，并非预测性信号。
个别资产仍可能因自身特殊原因而偏离整体标签所描述的方向。

up.en: Risk-on — riskier assets broadly outperforming safer ones.
up.zh: 风险偏好——风险资产整体跑赢避险资产。

down.en: Risk-off — safer assets broadly outperforming riskier ones.
down.zh: 避险——避险资产整体跑赢风险资产。

neutral.en: Mixed — no clear broad-based sentiment across asset classes.
neutral.zh: 混合——各类资产之间未呈现明确的整体情绪方向。
